query:
-- الحصول على بيانات المسافرين إلى الصين مع تفاصيلهم الديموغرافية
WITH china_travelers AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    exit_timestamp AS return_date,
    gender,
    nationality
  FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala
  WHERE destination = 'الصين'
    AND exit_timestamp >= '2016-01-01'
    AND exit_timestamp <= '2025-12-31'
    AND exit_timestamp NOT IN ('1902-01-01', '1903-01-01')
)
SELECT 
  t.gender,
  t.nationality,
  FLOOR(DATEDIFF(NOW(), d.birth_date) / 365.25) AS exact_age,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS person_count
FROM china_travelers t
INNER JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d ON t.id = d.id
WHERE d.birth_date IS NOT NULL 
  AND d.birth_date > '1900-01-01'
GROUP BY t.gender, t.nationality, exact_age
ORDER BY person_count DESC
LIMIT 30
